report_topic: Performance Audit on Land Records Management
observations_summary: Digitization of land records in Tamil Nadu improved access and transparency, but the scheme's outcomes were hindered by significant deficiencies in converting manual records to digital, abnormal delays in launching online services for Natham land records and e-Adangal, and unresolved issues affecting transparency and timely online patta transfers. Further deficiencies were noted in data linkage, asset management, data security, and monitoring.
